suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam security impact analysis and mainnet fork decision
suggestions.rationale: EIP-8037/8038 vulnerability affecting 13+ DeFi projects discovered in ACDE #248; mainnet fork date deferred pending full impact analysis. This is the critical blocker for Glamsterdam.
Deferred from ACDE #247 with explicit 'next call' revisit expected. Addresses DoS surface created by EIP-7954 raising contract limit without metering.
bogota-devnet-2 was scheduled to launch week of Oct 26; hegota-devnet-0 (first merged EL+CL devnet) targets post-Devcon. Status update expected given Devcon has passed.
